finding_admission.note: No newly discovered compiler finding is admitted in v1. Historical studies remain explicitly labelled adapters, not corpus discoveries.

metamorphic_properties.title: Elementwise addition commutes
metamorphic_properties.description: x + y and y + x produce equivalent elementwise outputs.

metamorphic_properties.title: Double transpose is identity
metamorphic_properties.description: Transposing a rank-two tensor twice restores the original tensor.

metamorphic_properties.title: Reshape round trip is identity
metamorphic_properties.description: Flattening and restoring a rank-two tensor preserves every element.

metamorphic_properties.title: Matrix product transpose rule
metamorphic_properties.description: (x @ y).T and y.T @ x.T produce equivalent outputs.

metamorphic_properties.title: Double negation is identity
metamorphic_properties.description: Negating a tensor twice preserves values and signed zero.

metamorphic_properties.title: Subtraction is addition of negation
metamorphic_properties.description: x - y and x + (-y) produce equivalent elementwise outputs.

metamorphic_properties.title: Absolute value is idempotent
metamorphic_properties.description: abs(x) and abs(abs(x)) produce equivalent outputs.

metamorphic_properties.title: Integer elementwise addition commutes
metamorphic_properties.description: int32 x + y and y + x produce equivalent elementwise outputs.

metamorphic_properties.title: Float64 elementwise addition commutes
metamorphic_properties.description: float64 x + y and y + x produce equivalent outputs in an explicit JAX x64 process.

metamorphic_properties.title: Mixed int32/float32 addition commutes
metamorphic_properties.description: int32 x + float32 y and float32 y + int32 x use same-operation promotion semantics consistently.

metamorphic_properties.title: Double negation preserves signed zero
metamorphic_properties.description: Negating signed-zero inputs twice preserves both values and zero signs.

metamorphic_properties.title: Absolute value is idempotent for non-finite inputs
metamorphic_properties.description: abs(x) and abs(abs(x)) agree for NaN, infinities, and signed zero under the explicit policy.

metamorphic_properties.title: Absolute value is idempotent for finite extremes
metamorphic_properties.description: abs(x) and abs(abs(x)) agree for finite values spanning normal and subnormal boundaries.

metamorphic_properties.title: Elementwise maximum commutes
metamorphic_properties.description: maximum(x, y) and maximum(y, x) produce equivalent elementwise outputs.

metamorphic_properties.title: Elementwise minimum commutes
metamorphic_properties.description: minimum(x, y) and minimum(y, x) produce equivalent elementwise outputs.

metamorphic_properties.title: Min-max duality relation
metamorphic_properties.description: minimum(x, y) equals -maximum(-x, -y) elementwise.

metamorphic_properties.title: Square is self-multiplication
metamorphic_properties.description: square(x) and mul(x, x) produce equivalent elementwise outputs.

metamorphic_properties.title: Square of negation is identity with square
metamorphic_properties.description: square(x) and square(-x) produce equivalent elementwise outputs.

metamorphic_properties.title: Min-max global reduction duality
metamorphic_properties.description: min(x) and -max(-x) produce equivalent reduction outputs.

metamorphic_properties.title: Elementwise multiplication commutes
metamorphic_properties.description: x * y and y * x produce equivalent elementwise outputs.

metamorphic_properties.title: Minimum and maximum sum identity
metamorphic_properties.description: minimum(x, y) + maximum(x, y) equals x + y elementwise.

metamorphic_properties.title: Square of absolute value is square
metamorphic_properties.description: square(abs(x)) and square(x) produce equivalent elementwise outputs.

metamorphic_properties.title: Multiplication negation duality
metamorphic_properties.description: (-x) * y equals -(x * y) elementwise.

metamorphic_properties.title: Global sum reduction negation duality
metamorphic_properties.description: sum(-x) equals -sum(x) for global reduction.

metamorphic_properties.title: Absolute value of negation is absolute value
metamorphic_properties.description: abs(-x) and abs(x) produce equivalent elementwise outputs preserving signed zero.

metamorphic_properties.title: Maximum and minimum idempotence
metamorphic_properties.description: maximum(x, x) and minimum(x, x) produce equivalent elementwise outputs equal to x.

metamorphic_properties.title: Lattice min-max absorption identity
metamorphic_properties.description: maximum(x, minimum(x, y)) and minimum(x, maximum(x, y)) produce equivalent elementwise outputs equal to x.

metamorphic_properties.title: Absolute value product distributivity
metamorphic_properties.description: abs(x * y) and abs(x) * abs(y) produce equivalent elementwise outputs.

metamorphic_properties.title: Square root of square identity
metamorphic_properties.description: sqrt(square(x)) and abs(x) produce equivalent elementwise outputs.

metamorphic_properties.title: Global mean reduction negation duality
metamorphic_properties.description: mean(-x) and -mean(x) produce equivalent reduction outputs.

metamorphic_properties.title: Multiplication distributes over addition
metamorphic_properties.description: x * (y + z) and (x * y) + (x * z) produce equivalent elementwise outputs.

metamorphic_properties.title: Addition associativity
metamorphic_properties.description: (x + y) + z and x + (y + z) produce equivalent elementwise outputs.

metamorphic_properties.title: Multiplication associativity
metamorphic_properties.description: (x * y) * z and x * (y * z) produce equivalent elementwise outputs.

metamorphic_properties.title: Square absolute self-multiplication identity
metamorphic_properties.description: abs(x * x) and square(abs(x)) produce equivalent elementwise outputs.

metamorphic_properties.title: Cosine even function symmetry
metamorphic_properties.description: cos(x) and cos(-x) produce equivalent elementwise outputs.

metamorphic_properties.title: Min-Max De Morgan negation duality
metamorphic_properties.description: min(x, y) equals -max(-x, -y) across all real values.

metamorphic_properties.title: Hyperbolic tangent odd symmetry
metamorphic_properties.description: tanh(-x) equals -tanh(x) across the differentiable domain.

metamorphic_properties.title: Sine odd function symmetry
metamorphic_properties.description: sin(-x) and -sin(x) produce equivalent elementwise values.

metamorphic_properties.title: Absolute distance subtraction symmetry
metamorphic_properties.description: |x - y| equals |y - x| preserving metric symmetry and signed zero.

metamorphic_properties.title: Lattice min-max sandwich absorption
metamorphic_properties.description: min(x, max(x, y)) evaluates to max(x, x) = x identically.
